name: Candy Bonez 1g Live Resin Disposables
description:
Lineage: Sherb Cream Pie x Obama Runtz

Type: Indica-dominant Hybrid

Terpenes: Limonene, ß-Myrcene, ß-Caryophyllene

Effects: Relaxed, Creative, Happy

Aroma: Sweet Cream, Citrus, Earthy Spice

Candy Bonez is a sweet, flavorful ride that will have your taste buds dancing. A tantalizing mix of Sherb Cream Pie and Obama Runtz, this strain wraps you in a sugary, creamy blanket with a burst of citrus brightness. The effects are the perfect blend of relaxation and euphoria, sparking creativity and a carefree happiness that makes every moment feel like a celebration. Let Candy Bonez take you on a smooth, sweet journey where chill vibes and inspired thoughts collide.
